t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes appear as a set of two each time. one of the gnomes will always be worth more points and this will be the same gnomes for that specific set each time. This means that it is possible to figure out which gnome will provide more points fairly quickly. The sets of gnomes can change however - there a a number of different coloured gnomes and these will change at different intervals and appear with different gnomes. The task is then the to figure out the new highest earning gnome from that set

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes always appear as a pair. There are multiple colour combinations for each pair and one of the gnomes is always worth more points. Each colour combination will appear at multiple and different times throughout the game. It is important to try and test which of the gnomes in each combination is worth more and then make a mental note of this. It can be tricky remembering which colour is worth more because that colour can also appear in a different combination and be worth less. For example a yellow gnome and a blue gnome may appear with the yellow gnome being worth more points. Following them a yellow and a green gnome may appear but the green gnome is worth more this time. The sets of gnomes and the colour combinations appear multiple times per round but this will change at certain points and a new combination will be introduced.
